sources.title: HST public image observations
sources.scope: Public HST image observation metadata from locked, dated MAST CAOM inputs. A historical baseline may be combined with explicitly selected fresh pages; bounded supplements preserve original observations and do not establish a complete current inventory or a per-observation science-file inventory. Local estimated s_region matching links to the official MAST Products API.

sources.title: DES DR2 coadd Tile images
sources.scope: Official DR2 normal g/r/i/z/Y coadd file rows from ivoa_des_dr2.siav1; complete within the captured coadd selector, not all DES data products.
sources.query: SELECT object, fileref, filter, obs_pub_did, access_url, ra1, dec1, ra2, dec2, ra3, dec3, ra4, dec4 FROM ivoa_des_dr2.siav1 WHERE obs_pub_did LIKE '%#1' AND filter IN ('g','r','i','z','Y') AND fileref NOT LIKE '%nobkg%' ORDER BY obs_pub_did

sources.title: FDS DR1 science-image fields
sources.scope: The complete 97-row FDS DR1 science-image ObsCore roster (20 u, 26 g, 26 r, 25 i) from official ESO release 157; paired weight maps are retained as ancillary evidence, not spatial-unit image URIs. J2000 field polygons are transformed to estimated ICRS frame bounds; file availability is not verified per row.
sources.query: SELECT TOP 5000 dp_id, target_name, filter, obs_id, obs_creator_did, s_region, access_url, release_description FROM ivoa.ObsCore WHERE obs_collection = 'FDS' AND release_description = 'https://www.eso.org/rm/api/v1/public/releaseDescriptions/157' AND dataproduct_type = 'image' ORDER BY dp_id

sources.title: VPHAS+ DR4 unstacked OmegaCAM images
sources.scope: The exact 15,534-row ESO DR4 submission from release description 145, with source-listed unstacked OmegaCAM pawprint files and per-file UNION of CCD polygons. This is the final incremental submission, not a reconciled cumulative DR4 inventory; J2000 CCD bounds are transformed to estimated ICRS geometry, valid-pixel masks are not checked and only representative file availability is probed.
sources.query: SELECT TOP 5000 dp_id, target_name, filter, obs_id, obs_creator_did, s_region, access_url, release_description FROM ivoa.ObsCore WHERE obs_collection = 'VPHASplus' AND release_description = 'https://www.eso.org/rm/api/v1/public/releaseDescriptions/145' AND dataproduct_type = 'image' ORDER BY dp_id

sources.title: KiDS DR5 gri Tile images
sources.scope: The complete ESO DR5 g/r/i image roster, including both i epochs: 5,388 source-listed image rows across 1,347 Tiles. Each source-listed file is joined by exact filename to the official KiDS Astro-WISE wget list; the providers may deliver different FITS headers and are recorded as separate sources, not byte-identical mirrors. J2000 image-frame polygons are transformed to estimated ICRS bounds; valid-pixel masks are not checked and individual file availability remains unverified.
sources.query: SELECT TOP 1000 dp_id, target_name, filter, obs_id, obs_creator_did, s_region, access_url, release_description FROM ivoa.ObsCore WHERE obs_collection = 'KIDS' AND release_description = 'https://www.eso.org/rm/api/v1/public/releaseDescriptions/229' AND dataproduct_type = 'image' AND filter IN ('g_SDSS','r_SDSS','i_SDSS') ORDER BY dp_id

sources.title: Gaia DR3 main-source file partitions
sources.scope: Official Gaia DR3 gaia_source file roster; ICRS/NESTED order 8 inclusive ranges. Approximate source-ID position, not source occupancy or an image footprint. File bytes and upstream MD5 have not been independently verified.

sources.title: SDSS DR9 resolve fields
sources.scope: Official DR9 window_flist rerun 301 run/camcol/field membership and great-circle window bounds. Estimated ICRS geometry, not per-band image WCS or valid-pixel coverage; documented frame URIs are unverified.

sources.title: GALEX public image observation metadata
sources.scope: Locked public MAST image observations with original s_region and explicit GR6/GR7 source-URI evidence. Band/release/project selectors apply; bounded snapshots do not establish complete GALEX inventory.

sources.title: JWST early-release public NIRCam observations
sources.scope: Observed public calibrated MAST image metadata for the existing Carina and SMACS0723 NIRCam products. Explicit proposal and instrument selectors; planned or test records are excluded. Not an all-JWST inventory.

sources.title: VVV DR4 incremental Tile image metadata
sources.scope: ESO ObsCore rows restricted to the exact VVV DR4 release-description URL and image products. This captures the 11,452-row DR4 submission increment (including Ks metadata), not the cumulative DR4 inventory; only rows with H/J/Y/Z DataLink #this records receive direct file URIs. Footprints are transformed from ObsCore J2000 to ICRS and remain estimated; valid-pixel masks are not available.

sources.title: SkyMapper DR4 g/r/i CCD metadata (2014-03-15 to 18 increment)
sources.scope: The complete 2014-03-15 <= image_id < 2014-03-18 g/r/i CCD metadata increment (5,666 rows) from official dr4.ccds. This is not the full DR4 inventory. The source supplies CCD ICRS polygon estimates and original filenames; each access URI is a rule-derived 5-arcmin SIAP FITS cutout, not the complete CCD file. Cutout availability has not been checked per URI.
sources.query: SELECT image_id, ccd, filter, filename, coverage FROM dr4.ccds WHERE image_id >= 20140315000000 AND image_id < 20140318000000 AND filter IN ('g','r','i') ORDER BY image_id, ccd

sources.title: 2MASS 6X Atlas images (M31 one-degree increment)
sources.scope: One bounded 1.0-degree NASA/IPAC IRSA SIA query centered at ICRS 10.6847083, 41.26875 for dataset sx (6X Catalog), type A Atlas images. The 138 band-images cover 46 coadds in J/H/K and are not the full 6X inventory. Source FK5/J2000 SIN WCS frame edges are transformed to estimated ICRS polygons. sources.title: ACT DR5 normal ACT-only whole-map FITS files
sources.scope: The six normal ACT-only ACT DR5 whole maps for 090/150/220 GHz with night/daynight selections. These are individual direct FITS files, not Tiles and not tar archives. FITS headers declare ICRS CAR maps with 43,200x10,320x3 axes; frame-edge geometry is an estimated RA/Dec envelope, not valid-pixel coverage. ACT+Planck, source-subtracted, variance and other roster products are excluded; full ACT DR5 product inventory is not claimed.
sources.query: Official ACT DR5 normal ACT-only whole-map selector: frequencies 090/150/220 GHz x night/daynight; lock the six matching FITS members from the official 42-file download script and capture only their FITS header blocks.

sources.title: DECaPS DR2 CCD image extensions
sources.scope: Complete 1,065,941-row DECaPS DR2 SIAv1 image-table inventory across g/i/r/Y/z, keyed by the source obs_pub_did including each FITS CCD extension. Source-listed Data Lab URLs identify the full CCD extension without POS/SIZE cutout parameters. Explicit SIAv1 ICRS corner coordinates use TPV image geometry and remain estimated frame bounds; valid-pixel masks and per-file availability are unverified.
sources.query: SELECT obs_collection, propid, obs_id, obs_pub_did, access_url, access_format, access_estsize, filter, im_naxis1, im_naxis2, wcsaxes1, wcsaxes2, date_obs, mjd_obs, expnum, exptime, fileref, proctype, prodtype, obstype, telescope, instrument_name, object, ra1, dec1, ra2, dec2, ra3, dec3, ra4, dec4 FROM ivoa_decaps_dr2.siav1 WHERE filter IN ('g','i','r','Y','z') ORDER BY obs_pub_did

sources.title: VIKING DR1 J-band Tile images
sources.scope: Source-listed J-band VIKING DR1 Tile images from ESO release description 24. The locked selector returns 110 unique numeric Tile IDs while the release document declares 151 survey Tiles; this is a partial image roster, not complete VIKING J coverage. Original POLYGON J2000 image frames are transformed to estimated ICRS bounds; valid-pixel masks and per-file availability are unverified.
sources.query: SELECT TOP 5000 dp_id, target_name, filter, obs_id, obs_creator_did, s_region, access_url, release_description, dataproduct_subtype FROM ivoa.ObsCore WHERE obs_collection = 'VIKING' AND release_description = 'https://www.eso.org/rm/api/v1/public/releaseDescriptions/24' AND dataproduct_type = 'image' AND filter = 'J' AND (dataproduct_subtype IS NULL OR dataproduct_subtype = '') ORDER BY dp_id

sources.title: AllWISE W3/W4 Atlas Tile images
sources.scope: Complete 36,480-row W3/W4 intensity-image roster from the official AllWISE allwise_p3am_cdd TAP table: 18,240 coadd Tiles per band, with identical coadd ID sets. This is the declared Atlas source-table inventory; J2000 image-frame corners become estimated ICRS geometry, valid-pixel masks are unchecked, and individual file availability is unverified.
sources.query: SELECT TOP 1000 coadd_id, band, ra1, dec1, ra2, dec2, ra3, dec3, ra4, dec4, crval1, crval2, crpix1, crpix2, naxis1, naxis2, ctype1, ctype2, cdelt1, cdelt2, crota2, equinox, cntr FROM allwise_p3am_cdd WHERE band IN (3,4) ORDER BY coadd_id, band

sources.title: CFHTLS Wide T0007 single-band median images
sources.scope: The complete 855-file CAOM selector for CFHTLS Wide T0007 single-band u/g/r/i/z median FITS images: 171 fields per band, with i split across 139 MP9701 and 32 MP9702 products. The separate 110 gri/gry/ryg RGB artifacts are excluded from this single-band source. CAOM ICRS frame polygons describe image frames, not valid-pixel masks; the listed CADC whole-file API route is derived from the source cadc: artifact URI and individually unverified.
sources.query: SELECT TOP 1000 o.collection, o.observationID, o.obsID, p.productID, p.provenance_version, p.energy_bandpassName, p.position_bounds, p.position_dimension_naxis1, p.position_dimension_naxis2, a.artifactID, a.uri, a.productType, a.contentType, a.contentLength, a.contentChecksum, c.position_coordsys, c.position_equinox FROM caom2.Observation AS o JOIN caom2.Plane AS p ON o.obsID=p.obsID JOIN caom2.Artifact AS a ON a.planeID=p.planeID JOIN caom2.Part AS pt ON pt.artifactID=a.artifactID JOIN caom2.Chunk AS c ON c.partID=pt.partID WHERE o.collection='CFHTTERAPIX' AND o.observationID LIKE 'CFHTLS_W_%' AND p.provenance_version='T0007' AND a.productType='science' AND a.uri LIKE '%_T0007_MEDIAN.fits' AND p.energy_bandpassName IN ('g.MP9401','i.MP9701','i.MP9702','r.MP9601','u.MP9301','z.MP9801') ORDER BY o.observationID,p.productID,a.uri

sources.title: Pan-STARRS DR1 zone 23 stack skycells
sources.scope: All official zone 23 grid skycells (projection cells 1322-1411, 9,000 requested identities; approximately Dec 0-4 degrees across all RA). Only source-listed DR1 stack files with badflag=0 are indexed. The service responses and official grid table are locked as evidence. File URIs are direct STScI FITS links; individual availability and valid-pixel masks are unverified. This bounded zone is not the full Pan-STARRS DR1 inventory. Frame polygons follow the documented PS1 grid WCS rule, cross-checked against one metadata-only FITS header, and remain estimated.
sources.query: skycell={projection}.{subcell}&type=stack

sources.title: IPHAS DR2 recalibration-member CCD images
sources.scope: Pinned author-owned IPHAS DR2 image-pipeline metadata; only in_dr2 recalibration members are indexed, keyed by run/CCD with band retained. sources.query: Pinned author pipeline table; retain rows where in_dr2=true, group by run+CCD and band; exclude no rows silently.

sources.title: Rubin First Look publisher TIFF images
sources.scope: Exactly the two NOIRLab original outreach TIFFs named by the CDS Rubin First Look source record. AVM Spatial.Quality is Position, so TAN image-frame footprints are estimated. These are public outreach images, not Rubin DP1 science exposures or a scientific Rubin inventory.
sources.query: Fixed source roster: noirlab2521a.tif and noirlab2521b.tif; capture BigTIFF IFD and AVM XMP metadata only.

sources.title: AKARI FIS version 2.1 all-sky region images
sources.scope: Complete IRSA akari.akari_images science-map inventory for the matching DARTS 2.1 region roster: 1,672 source-listed regions in each of N60, WideS, WideL and N160 (6,688 individual FITS files). Only N60/WideS/WideL bind to the existing CDS color product; N160 remains visible source evidence but is not falsely assigned to that color product. Four-corner J2000 image frames are converted to estimated ICRS geometry; valid-pixel masks are not checked and individual files are unverified.
sources.query: Four complete per-band science-image queries against akari.akari_images for N60, WideS, WideL and N160; preserve each raw VOTable and compare all rows to the source region list and band directories.

sources.title: ZTF DR7 CDS O3 reference-image progenitor metadata
sources.scope: Complete enumeration of served CDS DR7 g/r/i NESTED O3 HpxFinder metadata: 2,304 keys, 1,696 successful pages, 608 recorded 404 pages, 220,349 rows and 162,333 deduplicated reference-image quadrants. This is the CDS product's 2021 progenitor metadata scope, not a frozen or complete IRSA ZTF DR7 inventory; its J2000 image-frame polygons are estimated and current IRSA file bytes may differ from historical progenitors. Whole-file IRSA FITS paths follow the publisher's metadata.xml rule; only representative links were checked.
sources.query: Enumerate every g/r/i NESTED order-3 pixel key 0..767 from CDS DR7 HpxFinder; preserve each HTTP 200 body and HTTP 404 outcome and apply the advertised IRSA whole-file resolver.

sources.title: NVSS final intensity-map images
sources.scope: The complete 2,326-map I-only inventory enumerated by SkyView's published NVSS XML. NASA/GSFC SkyView is the reachable US mirror; NRAO's anonymous FTP route was unavailable during the 2026-10-06 audit. The full NVSS release includes additional Stokes planes outside this mirror selector. Each ICRS frame is estimated from that map's actual FK5/J2000 FITS WCS; valid-pixel masks and full-file availability are not verified.
sources.query: Parse every Images/Image row and SpellPrefix from the published NVSS XML; retain source-listed whole-map paths and each actual FITS primary header using validated byte ranges only.

sources.title: SUMSS final native mosaic images
sources.scope: The complete 748-map Galactic/Extragalactic roster enumerated by SkyView's published SUMSS XML (119 Galactic, 629 Extragalactic). NASA/GSFC SkyView is the only reachable whole-map mirror confirmed in the 2026-10-06 audit; the Sydney original archive was unavailable. Each ICRS frame is estimated from that map's actual FK5/J2000 FITS WCS; valid-pixel masks and full-file availability are not verified.
sources.query: Parse every Images/Image row and SpellPrefix from the published SUMSS XML; retain the exact Galactic/Extragalactic path and each actual FITS primary header using validated byte ranges only.

sources.title: WENSS final native map images
sources.scope: The complete 493-map HIGHRES inventory enumerated by SkyView's published WENSS XML (444 wn, 49 wp), recording the publisher's 325 MHz identity separately from each header's raw frequency metadata. NASA/GSFC SkyView is the reachable US mirror; original ASTRON/Leiden image routes were unavailable in the 2026-10-06 audit. Actual FITS WCS is transformed from FK4/B1950 to estimated ICRS frame bounds; the observed header-frequency conflict and unverified masks/full-file availability remain explicit.
sources.query: Parse every Images/Image row and SpellPrefix from the published WENSS XML; retain each whole-map path and actual FITS primary header using validated byte ranges only, without repairing raw frequency fields.

sources.title: Euclid Q1 released calibrated image frames
sources.scope: Q1_R1 released VIS and NISP calibrated frames from q1.calibrated_frame, with their own source-listed geometry. Separate from MER Tiles. Estimated ICRS frame bounds; no valid-pixel masks or complete science-file inventory.

sources.scope: EGBS-v1 observation 067070: 144 science exposures x 144 VIS quadrants. FITS TPV WCS frame bounds only; PSF calibration observations excluded, no valid-pixel masks or science arrays.
